fields.title: Kōgyō Meirei Fuguai ni kansuru Chōsa Hōkoku

case.subject: Fukusō suru hoshu meirei ni kansuru chōsa
case.incident: Minsei bu to gunji bu no aida no meirei no mujun ga kōgyō kikai no hoshu ni eikyō o ataeta

findings: Anbiro kan no bunsho o kenshō shita kekka, fukusō suru meirei ga jissai ni hassō sarete ita koto ga hanmei shita.
Kobayashi Isamu shi no seikyū wa kōgyō kasei no tame ni zettai ni hitsuyō de aru.
fields.conclusion: Bukyoku kan no bunsho fuguai ga kakunin sareta tame, seikyū o ukeireru (accept) koto ga datō de aru.
recommendations: Sumiyaka ni hoshu meirei o tōgō shi, sagyō o saikai sa seru koto.

claims.fact: Chōsa hōkoku wa anbiro kan no fukusō meirei o shin'yō shi, seikyū o ukeireru koto o shōmei shite iru.
